purpose: screen a full-fit corrector under the exact current Temporal+Visual deployment feature contract
known_limitation: meta-fold training inputs come from ordinary base-model OOF whose upstream models may have seen the meta-held users; this screen is deployment-aligned but not the strict causal estimate

visual_contract.quantization: fresh uniform 5-bit from each original FP16 checkpoint
visual_contract.inference: single view, matching release replay; no flip TTA

temporal_contract: frozen strictV3 residual TCN OOF/test logits
fusion_contract: Fusion absent; frozen full-release temperatures, weights and quality gate

corrector.objective: CE + 1.0 KL protection at baseline confidence >= 0.8

submission: one Kaggle submission explicitly authorized by the user only after every promotion gate passes
